title: A logarithmic phase singularity at the heart of Landau-Zener transitions
summary: Three ingredients of the elementary Landau-Zener problem determine the familiar expression $a_{LZ}\equiv\exp\left[-π/(2ε)\right]$ for the asymptotic value of the probability amplitude for remaining in the initial level: (i) A wave whose phase is determined by the product of a contour integral over a simple pole at the origin of the complex plane and the inverse of twice the scaled chirp parameter $ε$. (ii) An asymptotic limit of the associated path connecting the points $\pm 1$ along the real axis and circumventing the pole in the upper half-plane, and (iii) a half-circle in the lower half…
